Messages.Author: Michael Edwards (aka Shadowdragon)
Messages.Body:
Why do some clans get more vampires then others? In Sabbat War the
Brujah get 14 vampires; the Gangrel get 10 Vampires; The Lasombra and
the Tzimisce get 15 Vampires; the Malkavian, the Nosferatu, and the
Toreador get 9 Vampires; and the Ventrue get 13 Vampires. What if a
person wants to play a Nosferatu deck? Unless he or she uses doubles of
some Vampires the only way to get a full Crypt is to use Vampires from
other clans.

In the original Sabbat set there were 11 of each clan, including 11
Pander. They also had room for 11 Tremere Antitribu.

I appreciate Whit Wolf's efforts to revive V:TES but I really wish they
would do a better job of organizing the card sets.

Michael

WotC has a higher margin and printed more cards in the Sabbat set than
are in the Sabbat War set (not counting the pre-cons).

It is this higher margin, in fact, that kept any more sets from being
printed by WotC, AIUI. Attempting to replicate WotC's approach to the
game is probably not the best way to go.


